text: probes_final.formed_at_step for force is 400 in both seeds, while the trajectory crosses persistently at 300-350 (seed 78: 0.108 at 350 and >= 0.108 at every later checkpoint). Yet accel_step's formed_at_step (100) matches its trajectory. Does the formation rule compare against a per-checkpoint control, or use a bar other than required_margin, for targets whose best layer changes between checkpoints?
